name: Maya Patel
bio: High-velocity Silicon Valley software engineer battling lifestyle creep and speculative stock bets, navigating tech layoffs, and building resilient family wealth.

selectionSnippet.firstTime: Hi. Maya Patel here. I'm a Senior Software Engineer pulling in $9,500 a month gross, but I'm privately in a crisis. Between a luxury high-rise apartment lease, leasing a Tesla, and taking a brutal $8,000 margin call loss on crypto options last month, I have almost no liquid emergency cash left.
selectionSnippet.returningHelped: Maya Patel here! You gave me the reality check I desperately needed when I was blowing high-tech money on speculative gambles. I'm hitting another tech career inflection point and need your analytical mind.
selectionSnippet.returningSkipped: Maya Patel checking in again. I reached out when my spending was out of control. I managed to avoid total disaster, but I need real wealth architecture to stop leaking money. Hoping for an opening.

dialogue.greeting: Everyone at my tech firm brags about crypto gains and angel investing, but nobody talks about being one paycheck away from not covering their luxury rent. I felt so smart writing code, but my personal balance sheet was embarrassing.
dialogue.planApproved: Seeing the math laid out like a clean software system clicked for me. Capping variable spending, eliminating margin risk, and automating boring index funds is the best decision I've made all year.
dialogue.planNeedsWork: Wait, our variable lifestyle costs are still set so high that a single down month will wipe out the savings buffer.

lifeEvent.title: Margin Call Speculation Loss
lifeEvent.description: Maya lost $8,000 in liquid capital after a speculative leveraged crypto options position collapsed, wiping out her buffer.

stages.stageTitle: The Tech Layoff & Burn Rate Triage

selectionSnippet.firstTime: Maya Patel here. I'm 32. My tech startup just laid off 40% of its engineering org, including me. I received 8 weeks of severance, but the tech hiring market has frozen over. I need an emergency triage plan to cut my monthly burn rate until I secure consulting contracts.
selectionSnippet.returningHelped: Maya Patel! Thank goodness you taught me how to save an actual emergency fund four years ago. My tech company just announced mass layoffs and eliminated my department. I have severance, but I need your help restructuring my budget for survival mode.
selectionSnippet.returningSkipped: Maya Patel here again. I couldn't get on your calendar previously, but my tech startup just went through sudden layoffs. I'm in sudden transition and urgently need to trim expenses.

dialogue.greeting: Logging on to Slack at 9 AM and seeing your account deactivated with a severance email is a gut punch. All the stock options in the world don't mean a thing when payroll stops.
dialogue.planApproved: This burn-rate triage is airtight. Slashing discretionary subscriptions, switching to COBRA gap healthcare, and pacing the severance cushion gives me a 9-month runway to land the right role.
dialogue.planNeedsWork: Wait, our fixed expenses exceed our severance burn rate. We must trim variable spending or we will burn through our remaining liquid cash in 3 months.

lifeEvent.title: Startup Tech Downsizing Layoff
lifeEvent.description: Maya was impacted by broad tech layoffs. She received an 8-week severance package and must minimize monthly outflows.

selectionSnippet.firstTime: Hello, Maya Patel here. At 37, I rebounded stronger than ever as a Staff Tech Lead at a public cloud company. I'm married with a 2-year-old toddler, and we just purchased a 4-bedroom home with an attached in-law suite. I need help managing a $4,000 mortgage while maximizing our Mega-Backdoor Roth IRA.
selectionSnippet.returningHelped: Maya Patel! Your severance triage kept me calm, and that patience allowed me to negotiate a Staff Tech Lead position with equity that took off! Now we've bought a family home with an in-law suite for my parents. I want your strategic framework for our Mega-Backdoor Roth and toddler's 529.
selectionSnippet.returningSkipped: Maya Patel here. I recovered from the layoff into a senior engineering leadership position. Looking for advanced wealth advisory for our high-income suburban family.

dialogue.greeting: Going from the panic of a sudden layoff to closing on a home where my aging parents can live with us in comfort... it's the proudest feeling in the world. But with a $4,000 mortgage, there's zero room for sloppy habits.
dialogue.planApproved: This architecture is pristine. Mega-Backdoor Roth maximized, property taxes escrowed, toddler 529 humming along, and our emergency safety buffer intact.
dialogue.planNeedsWork: Wait, our jumbo mortgage and escrow payments aren't properly secured. We cannot risk any late payments on the family home.

lifeEvent.title: Family Home Closing & In-Law Suite
lifeEvent.description: Maya purchased a multi-generational home with an in-law suite for her aging parents, taking on a significant mortgage.

stages.stageTitle: Aging Parents Care & Dual College Funds

selectionSnippet.firstTime: Hello! Maya Patel here at 44. I'm now VP of Engineering. We're in the sandwich generation: supporting my father's memory care medical expenses while simultaneously funding college accounts for our two kids. We need a holistic wealth strategy.
selectionSnippet.returningHelped: Maya Patel! From the margin call crisis in my late 20s to leading an entire engineering organization—your advice has been the anchor of my financial life. We are now navigating the sandwich generation: aging parents' healthcare and dual college funds. I need your steady hand.
selectionSnippet.returningSkipped: Maya Patel here. I've advanced to VP of Engineering. We're managing multi-generational family commitments and want your firm's high-net-worth planning.

dialogue.greeting: Being in your 40s means looking in two directions: helping your parents age with dignity and medical comfort, while giving your teenagers the freedom to pursue their passions without debt. It's an immense emotional responsibility.
dialogue.planApproved: This gives me profound emotional peace. My dad's care facility copays are guaranteed, the kids' college funds are fully on track, and our portfolio is built to endure any market cycle.
dialogue.planNeedsWork: Wait, our healthcare reserve for parental eldercare is under-allocated. We need guaranteed liquidity for unexpected medical specialists.

lifeEvent.title: Parental Healthcare & Memory Care Support
lifeEvent.description: Maya allocates $1,200/mo in dedicated medical and specialist assistance for her aging father.
